description: Kenya Drought Biomes is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC). Anthropogenic biomes, also known as anthromes or human biomes, are ecosystems significantly altered by human activity. They represent the terrestrial biosphere in its contemporary, human-modified form, using global ecosystem units defined by patterns of sustained human interaction. These biomes are categorized based on factors like population density and agricultural practice. Coverage: Kenya. The portal files it under the publisher IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC). Its tags are environment, geodata. It offers 1 resource(s) in GEOTIFF. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
